svg.title: Hen house power wiring
svg.desc: A 12 volt supply through a fuse to a plus terminal block and a ground terminal block, feeding the LM2596 module with the ESP32, the L298N with the door motor, and the XY-MOS with the coop light.
svg.text: Every device has its own wire pair back to the + block and the GND block. The fuse sits before the + block.
1. Set the LM2596 to 5.0 V with a multimeter BEFORE the ESP32 is connected.
2. Fuse: above the motor running current, below its stall current. Leave the L298N regulator jumper fitted and its 5 V terminal unconnected.
3. ESP32 ground reaches the L298N and XY-MOS only through the GND block (LM2596 IN- and OUT- are common: check with a continuity beep).
4. Test the motor direction on the bench first. If "open" turns it the wrong way, swap OUT1 and OUT2.
